metadata.name: Save a draft into your mailbox
metadata.description: Use “Save a draft into your mailbox” in Recued. Copies a draft you already saved into that same mail account's own Drafts folder, so you can finish it in your phone or desktop mail client. It does not send — parking a message and sending it stay separate. Saving again updates the mailbox copy where your provider allows. Attachments stay in Recued.
metadata.author: recued-core
